_comment: HARNESS-04 (ADR 0019 follow-up): mutation testing scoped to the security-critical BFF core. Q1b proves tests aren't WEAKENED; this proves they aren't HOLLOW — a surviving mutant is a behaviour change no test caught. Scoped to rbac/auth/approvals (scope enforcement + four-eyes), the high-class audit emission (audit immutability + PII redaction at emission — a CLAUDE.md hard stop), and the Idempotency-Key 24h dedup window (binding API convention); all DB-free (vitest.mutation.config.ts) so it runs fast and hermetically. HARNESS-13 RATCHET: break was 65 against a 70.3% baseline — five points of slack, so the control could decay a long way before failing. Re-measured 2026-08-06 over 493 mutants: 71.20% (351 killed / 116 survived) on vitest 2, and 70.99% (350/117) on vitest 3 after the HARNESS-12 bump — a one-mutant delta, so ~0.2pp is the observed run-to-run noise floor. break is now 70: about one point (~5 mutants) of headroom, which absorbs that noise and fails on real decay. Raise it again as the 117 survivors are killed; never lower it to make a red run green.
